Moving in Boldmere: What You Need to Know

Moving in Boldmere means planning around 3 things: parking on Boldmere Road, access at terraced and semi-detached homes, and the route out past Chester Road. Boldmere sits between Sutton Park, the Cross-City railway line and Chester Road, on the south-west side of Sutton Coldfield.

Boldmere Road carries the local shops, the library and bus stops, so loading space there is limited. Tell us about parking, driveways and stairs when you ask for a quote, and the quote is built on that access.

Moving into central Birmingham? Boldmere is outside the Birmingham Clean Air Zone (CAZ), which covers the roads inside the A4540 Middleway. Our vans are CAZ compliant, so you pay no CAZ charge on our vehicles at either end.

How Much Do House Removals in Boldmere Cost?

House removals in Boldmere cost from £400 – £700 for a 1-bed house to £1,000 – £1,800 for a 4-bed house, for a local move under 50 miles (80 km). These are guide prices. Your quote is fixed once agreed.

Property sizeGuide price (local move)
1-bed house£400 – £700
2-bed house£600 – £1,000
3-bed house£800 – £1,400
4-bed house£1,000 – £1,800
5+ bed house£1,400 – £2,500+

Smaller jobs are booked by the hour, with a 2-hour minimum: £40 – £60 an hour for 1 man and a van, £60 – £95 for 2 men and a van, and £70 – £110 for 3 men and a Luton van.

Your price depends on 4 factors: the amount you are moving, the distance, access at both addresses, and extras such as packing or storage. Weekend moves cost 10% to 20% more. Month-end dates cost 15% more. Any change in scope is discussed with you before the move.

Property Types We Move in Boldmere

Property types in Boldmere fall into 5 groups: terraced houses, semi-detached family homes, detached houses, flats and flats above shops. Pick your group on the quote form, so the crew and van fit the home.

  • 01 Terraced houses: Narrow halls and stairs mean large pieces often come apart before a terraced house move.
  • 02 Semi-detached family homes: A semi-detached house move often includes a loft, so put the loft on your inventory.
  • 03 Detached houses, such as those on Station Road: Driveway or kerbside loading changes the plan, so say which applies.
  • 04 Flats and apartments: Flat removals turn on the stairs and the carry to the van, so give us both.
  • 05 Flats above shops on Boldmere Road: Rear or side access can make loading easier, so mention it if your flat has it.

Fully Insured House Removals in Boldmere

Fully insured removals in Boldmere include Goods in Transit (GIT) cover up to £50,000 and £5 million of public liability cover.

Your belongings stay protected by GIT insurance through loading, the drive and unloading. Public liability cover applies to injury or property damage on move day.

Anything you pack yourself, and anything in storage, sits outside the GIT policy.

Parking for the Removal Van

Parking for the removal van in Boldmere falls under Birmingham City Council, since Boldmere is part of Birmingham. That makes a Birmingham parking dispensation available for a Boldmere address, so read the council's current terms.

Boldmere Road has shops and bus stops, so loading along it takes planning.

If Your Completion Is Delayed

If your completion is delayed, we send updates by phone or WhatsApp as the day unfolds. Request storage, if the keys are held back.

Boldmere Removal FAQs

How much is a house removal in Boldmere?+
A house removal in Boldmere costs £400 – £700 for a 1-bed house and up to £1,400 – £2,500+ for a 5+ bed house. The figures cover local moves under 50 miles (80 km), and the agreed quote stays fixed.
How can I move house cheaply in Boldmere?+
Choose man and van, charged hourly with a 2-hour minimum. Expect £40 – £60 per hour for 1 man and a van, or £60 – £95 per hour with 2 men. View the hourly rates.
How far in advance should I book removals in Boldmere?+
Book removals in Boldmere 2–4 weeks ahead, where you can. Short-notice moves depend on crew availability.
Are my belongings insured during the move?+
Yes. Goods-in-transit cover protects your belongings up to £50,000, alongside public liability cover of up to £5 million. Self-packed items are outside the goods-in-transit policy. See what the insurance leaves out.
Do you take apart and rebuild furniture?+
Yes. The crew takes beds, wardrobes and tables apart, then rebuilds them at your new address. Add these pieces to your quote request.
Can I get a parking dispensation for the removal van in Boldmere?+
Yes. Boldmere is part of Birmingham, so Birmingham City Council handles parking dispensations there. Read the council's current terms before applying.
Do you work weekends and bank holidays?+
Yes. Crews move homes 7 days a week, weekends and bank holidays included. Bank holiday moves are priced when you get your quote, and weekend moves carry a 10% to 20% surcharge.
Where can I read reviews of The Royals Removals?+
Our reviews are on Google, with a 5.0 rating, and on Trustpilot. Visit our reviews page.
